items.problem: 'Make an offer' became 'Raise the price' (price/money option).

items.english: Suggested from the app’s price book: about R{price}/kg wholesale. Farm-gate, not shop shelf — change it to whatever you actually want.
items.draft: Kucetyiswa kwincwadi yamaxabiso ye-app: malunga ne-R{price}/kg ngobuninzi. Ixabiso lasefama, hayi leshelufu yevenkile — lutshintshe libe linani oliyifunayo ngokwenene.
items.corrected: Kucetyiswa kwincwadi yamaxabiso ye-app: malunga ne-R{price}/kg ngexabiso lokuthengisa ngobuninzi. Ixabiso lasefama, hayi leshelufu yevenkile — lutshintshe libe linani oliyifunayo ngokwenene.

items.english: Enter an amount above zero, or choose Swap, Free or Make an offer.
items.draft: Faka inani elingaphezulu kwezero, okanye ukhethe Tshintshiselana, Simahla okanye Phakamisa ixabiso.
items.corrected: Faka inani elingaphezulu kwezero, okanye ukhethe Tshintshiselana, Simahla okanye Nika isiphakamiso.

items.english: What would you take? e.g. maize seed or pumpkin seed
items.draft: Wena wawuthatha ntoni? umz. imbewu yombona okanye yethanga
items.problem: 'What would you take?' (in swap) became past tense.
items.corrected: Ungathatha ntoni? umz. imbewu yombona okanye yethanga
